title: Industry Swapper Plug-in
blurb: A real-time customizable direct mail mock-up generator across industries.
about: Industry Swapper Plug-in is a direct mail mock-up generator that re-skins one postcard template for any industry in real time. Pick a variant from the Mock Library on the right to swap the copy, colours and imagery, use the zoom controls to inspect the details, and choose Reset Default to return to the starting piece.

title: Postmark Awards
blurb: Text that flows along noise-driven ribbons, with live controls and SVG export.
about: Postmark Awards sets type flowing along a looping, noise-driven ribbon, built for awards and event graphics. Enter your own text in the control panel, one phrase per line, then adjust weight, spacing, thickness and wiggle. Choose Randomize Pattern for a new path and Download SVG to take the result into your design tools.

title: Marketing Minesweeper
blurb: A minesweeper where every mine reveals a direct mail marketing tip.
about: Marketing Minesweeper is minesweeper rebuilt as a direct mail lesson, where every mine you uncover reveals a marketing tip. Click a square to reveal it. Right-click, or press and hold on a touch screen, to flag a suspected mine. Clear the board to win.

title: Pattern Generator
blurb: An ASCII pattern engine for brand backgrounds, with seven motifs, movable objects and live brand colours.
about: Pattern Generator is an ASCII pattern engine that turns rows of code, tickers and contract text into animated brand backgrounds. Pick a motif, then choose whether the pattern fills the wall, sits inside an object, or mixes both. Drag on the artboard to move a gem, circle, ring, square or your own word, and use the panel to set direction, speed, density, spacing and colour. Press 1 to 7 to switch motifs, Space to pause, and Export PNG to save the result.

title: Kick Off Type Lab
blurb: A type tool for groovy, gooey, western lettering, with live spacing, warp and SVG export.
about: Kick Off Type Lab is a lettering tool for groovy, gooey western type. Type straight onto the canvas and click between letters to place the cursor. Use the panel to change the font, spacing, gooeyness, warp, stretch and shadow, switch on Animate warp to set it moving, then copy or download the result as an SVG.

title: Palette Compositions
blurb: Click to cycle palettes through randomly composed line, grid and stripe layouts.
about: Palette Compositions is a study in how colour changes a layout, using randomly composed lines, grids and stripes. Click anywhere on the canvas to cycle to the next palette and redraw the composition.

title: Integratron
blurb: A 3D desert dome cycling from day to night, with sound bath bowls on click and scroll.
about: Integratron is a 3D desert dome that drifts from day to night, inspired by sound bath bowls. Click to ring a bowl and scroll to zoom the camera in and out, with each scroll adding a higher bowl tone. Turn your sound on.

title: Bento Brand Showcase
blurb: A tile layout of restaurant UI details: tip pools, guest checks, type specimens and palette cards you can click.
about: Bento Brand Showcase is a bento-style tile layout of restaurant interface details, including tip pools, guest checks, type specimens and palette cards. Click the tiles to interact with them: toggle a saved state, change the check split, tick off items and flip switches.

title: No-Code Binary Motif
blurb: Move the mouse and a diagonal wave flips a grid of 0s and 1s into colour.
about: No-Code Binary Motif is a grid of 0s and 1s that turns into colour as a diagonal wave sweeps across it. Move your mouse left and right to steer the wave, and watch the numbers flip into colour blocks behind it.

title: Temporary Notes
blurb: Brush across drifting bars to play notes; each bar fades into a rising echo.
about: Temporary Notes is a field of drifting bars you can play like an instrument. Click once to start the sound, then brush your mouse across the bars to trigger notes. Each bar fades out into a rising echo, and moving higher or lower on the screen opens or closes the filter.

title: Text Repeater
blurb: One word repeats outward in ever larger lines, pulsing from the centre in a ripple.
about: Text Repeater sets one word repeating outward in ever larger lines, pulsing from the centre in a ripple. Sit back and watch the rhythm, or resize the window to see the type rescale and the ripple reflow.

title: Metacognitive Prompt Helper
blurb: Rewrites a basic prompt into a metacognitive Identify, Evaluate, Update prompt with the Gemini API.
about: Metacognitive Prompt Helper rewrites a basic prompt into a metacognitive prompt that asks the model to identify, evaluate and update its thinking. Type or paste a prompt in the Input Prompt box, choose whether Thinking is on, and press Transform. Compare the original and rewritten prompts side by side, then use Copy Output.

title: Mail Stack
blurb: A ribbon of postcards flows along a curve; hover one to reveal its heatmap and reshape the path with the controls.
about: Mail Stack is a ribbon of postcards that flows along a curve and floats gently as it goes. Hover a card to reveal its heatmap. Open Controls to change the curve spread, float intensity, stack density and point density, or choose Randomize Curve Shape for a new path.

title: Brand Colors
blurb: Four colour panels wipe in and out in a staggered, eased sequence.
about: Brand Colors is four brand colour panels wiping in and out in a staggered, eased sequence. It runs on a loop, so watch how the timing and easing give flat colour a sense of character.

title: Postal Fix Animation
blurb: A full motion piece built entirely in code: stamps, cards and type animate in sequence like a video.
about: Postal Fix Animation is a full motion piece built entirely in code, with stamps, cards and type animating in sequence like a video. It plays on a loop. Click anywhere, or press R, to restart it from the beginning.

title: Brand Motion System
blurb: Pick a motion motif, set the brand palette and type, and drag the pieces around the frame.
about: Brand Motion System is a way of building brand motion from a few rules. Pick a motion motif such as Grow, Orbit, Stack or Macro, set the brand palette and type, and press Randomize for a new combination. Drag the pieces around the frame to compose your own layout.
